verdict.rationale: Weaviate's GitHub README explicitly states it combines vector search, keyword filtering, RAG, and reranking in a single query interface, indicating built-in reranking support, but the evidence pack lacks first-party docs detailing specific reranker modules (e.g., Cohere, transformers) or configuration guidance. missing for 10: dedicated reranker-module docs, list of supported reranking providers, hands-on validation of reranking quality/behavior.
